_about: v16 review fixes (notes/workflows/ledger-v16.json): strings added while fixing review-v16-*.json. id -> {en, ru, note}. Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v16-*.json).

fix.coincide.en: The curves coincide here, so their crossings are not defined
fix.coincide.ru: Здесь кривые совпадают, поэтому их точки пересечения не определены
fix.coincide.note: Reason of an undefined crossing point (constructions): a 3-point circle whose points are collinear to rounding met with that line (review math-5).

fix.br_line.en: Drag either end to choose the deformed steps
fix.br_line.ru: Перетащите любой конец, чтобы выбрать деформируемые шаги
fix.br_line.note: Tooltip of the deformation bracket's line over the cards (review user-3).

fix.mk_hint.en: Right-click the spiral, then Listen along.
fix.mk_hint.ru: Щёлкните спираль правой кнопкой и выберите «Слушать вдоль кривой».
fix.mk_hint.note: Toast when the Mountain King example opens (desktop); its button is Listen (review user-5). Keep the menu item's name as the v15.2 table has it.

fix.mk_hint_ph.en: Hold the spiral, then Listen along.
fix.mk_hint_ph.ru: Удерживайте палец на спирали и выберите «Слушать вдоль кривой».
fix.mk_hint_ph.note: The same toast on a phone (touch).

fix.listen.note: The toast's button: turns sound on if needed and listens along the spiral.

fix.listening.note: Chip over the X plane while a curve is listened along; {name} the curve's name (Spiral).

fix.listening_ph.note: The same chip on a phone (no Esc key).
